title.narrative: Tropical Forest Initiative – support to REDD+ Investment Programme phase II (RIP II) in Ethiopia, 2023-2026

description.narrative: REDD+ Investment Programme phase II (RIP II)’s objective is to contribute to Ethiopia’s Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) on the transformation of the forestry sector and reforestation to meet targets on emission reduction and to promote sustainable social and economic development.
